 Job Description
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and modernization of enterprise data solutions within the automotive, mobility, and financial services domain .
 In this role, you will work on a cloud-based data platform supporting vehicle leasing, customer services, operational processes, and financial reporting. You will help build reliable, scalable, and high-quality data pipelines that integrate information from multiple business systems and enable data-driven decision-making.
 You will collaborate closely with Data Architects, Business Analysts, Tech Leads, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver robust data integration and transformation solutions using Snowflake and AWS .
 Key Responsibilities:
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integration solutions using Snowflake and AWS
 Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from multiple enterprise systems
 Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and transformation logic within Snowflake 
 Implement data transformations, mappings, and business rules 
 Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and data processing workflows, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency
 Implement data quality controls, validation mechanisms, and reconciliation processes 
 Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate data requirements into reliable, production-ready implementations
 Support secure and controlled data processing practices, particularly when handling sensitive customer and financial information
 Implement monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement practices for data pipelines and integration workflows
 Contribute to CI/CD processes, technical documentation, and data engineering best practices.
 Qualifications
 Required Skills and Experience:
 Strong professional experience in Data Engineering , with a focus on enterprise data integration, transformation, and cloud-based data platforms
 Extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake , including data ingestion, transformation, data modeling, and performance optimization
 Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, analytical functions, stored procedures, and query optimization
 Solid experience with AWS cloud services
 Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architectures , data warehousing concepts, and enterprise data integration patterns
 Good understanding of relational and dimensional data modeling, data warehouse design principles, and analytical data structures
 Experience implementing data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and data validation mechanisms
 Understanding of data security, access controls, and data protection principles when working with sensitive or regulated information
 Familiarity with Git-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables, and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
 Nice to Have:
 Hands-on experience with dbt (data build tool) for SQL-based transformations, data modeling, testing, and documentation
 Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) , including developing, maintaining, or migrating enterprise ETL workflows
 Knowledge of Python for data processing, automation, and pipeline development
 Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow

 Global internal tech communities, hobby clubs and interest groups, inclusion and diversity programmes, events and celebrations.
